name: Homosexuals
overview: Scripture clearly identifies homosexual acts as sinful, describing them as an abomination in Leviticus 18:22 and 20:13 with severe consequences prescribed. However, Isaiah 56:3 reminds believers that those who align themselves with the Lord, including those who may feel marginalized like eunuchs, are not separated from His people. The New Testament calls all believers to love their neighbors as themselves (Matthew 22:39) and to treat others with the same kindness they desire (Matthew 7:12), while recognizing that not all can embrace every teaching (Matthew 19:11). This balance underscores God’s holiness and justice alongside His call to love and grace.
